observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment claims CLI and claim coordination event stream

verified_properties: Exact release by claim ID releases the caller's held claim without a repository argument.
The release transition retains the repository from the authoritative held claim record.
A foreign session's claim remains held when its ID is supplied to the caller's release operation.
The existing repository-based release form remains supported.
Conflicting exact-claim and repository release options fail without mutating claim state.
outcome.interpretation_limit: These tests verify exact-claim selection, ownership boundaries, compatibility, and event context. They do not establish cross-session usability or reduced agent intervention.

related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence and Continuous Improvement Campaign

measurement_limits: The focused Environment test and claim-recovery/generation suites were run; the full repository suite was not rerun for this interface change.
Passing tests do not establish independent agent receipt, repeated-use success, or intervention burden reduction.
